official.deadline_note: Two-stage call for the 2026-2027 round: stage-one nomination documents to the applicant's home-country authority (Ministry, Embassy, etc.) by 15 April 2026, 6 PM Baku time; shortlisted candidates then registered in SIACAS from 1 to 10 June 2026 (10 June, 6 PM Baku time). The 2026-2027 round has now closed (final arrival date 30 September 2026); the grant is awarded annually, so the next round is expected on the same early-year schedule, but 2027/2028 dates are not yet published.
official.status_note: The official portal publishes the 2026-2027 call, announced 11 February 2026; its stages ran February to September 2026 with candidate notification 1 July to 1 August 2026, academic year start 15 September 2026 and final arrival date 30 September 2026. The programme awards 100 grants annually, so a further round is expected, but as of 10 October 2026 no 2027/2028 call or dates have been posted.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The official call states the scholarship covers 'Tuition fee and language preparatory courses (in accordance with the language of instruction) for the study period at the undergraduate, graduate, general medicine, medical residency, doctoral level.'
official.funding_period: per month, 10 months a year except July and August
benefits: Tuition fee and language preparatory courses (in accordance with the language of instruction) for the study period at the undergraduate, graduate, general medicine, medical residency and doctoral levels
An international economy class flight ticket to Baku, Azerbaijan (from the country of origin) and from Azerbaijan (to the country of origin) once a year
Monthly allowance of 800 AZN (470 USD) for accommodation, daily expenses and educational materials, paid 10 months each year except July and August
Yearly allowance of 200 AZN (117 USD) for medical care and medication during the study period in the Republic of Azerbaijan
A single entry visa to the Republic of Azerbaijan and a temporary residence permit for the stay for the period of each academic year
eligibility: Citizens of member states of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation
Citizens of member states of the Non-Aligned Movement
Citizens of Small Island Developing States
Citizens of countries sharing common cultural, ethnic and historical ties with Azerbaijan
Age limits as of 15 September 2026: below 35 years for undergraduate and general medicine programmes, below 40 for graduate and medical residency programmes, below 45 for doctoral programmes
Citizens of the Republic of Azerbaijan, and individuals whose citizenship in the Republic of Azerbaijan has been terminated, will not be considered
requirements: Copy of diplomas and transcripts from the prior high school or higher education institution
Academic marks (GPA) of the previous degree(s) must not be less than 70 on a scale of 0 to 100, or 7 on a scale of 10, or the equivalent of the relevant marking system
Copy of a medical certificate including HIV/AIDS and Hepatitis B/C tests, dated no more than 3 months before the submission of the application
Copy of a valid passport confirming identification information
CV or resume and a motivation letter

Proficiency in the language of study: English-taught programmes require minimum IELTS 5 (TOEFL 40) for undergraduate and IELTS 5.5 (TOEFL 50) for postgraduate study, with the previous education's language of study in English; Russian, Turkish or Azerbaijani tracks require proof of language proficiency or prior study in that language
documents: Completed nomination form (for the first stage of the application process)
Copy of diplomas and transcripts from the prior high school or higher education institution
Copy of the medical certificate including HIV/AIDS and Hepatitis B/C tests
CV or resume, and motivation letter
selection_criteria: Official nomination by the respective government authorities (Ministries, Embassies, etc.) of the applicant's country in the first stage - only nominated applications go through evaluation
Review and evaluation of candidates by the respective government authorities, then by the Selection Committee through SIACAS
The final decision on the grant of the scholarships is solely up to the Selection Committee; all decisions made during the selection process are final and not subject to appeal
Official nomination by the applicant's government does not guarantee the grant of the scholarship
coverage: Tuition fees for the whole study period
Language preparatory courses in accordance with the language of instruction
International flights: one economy-class round trip per year between the home country and Baku
Monthly allowance of 800 AZN (470 USD) for accommodation, daily expenses and educational materials
Medical insurance allowance of 200 AZN (117 USD) per year
Visa and registration: single entry visa and temporary residence permit for each academic year
application_method: First stage: submit the completed nomination form and required documents to the relevant government authorities of the applicant's country (Ministries, Embassies, etc.); the last date of submission is 15 April 2026 at 6 PM Baku time

Second stage: officially nominated candidates apply through the Study in Azerbaijan Centralized Admission Service (SIACAS) website (portal.edu.az) from 1 to 10 June 2026, logging in and choosing the 'Heydar Aliyev - International Education Grant' admission channel

Candidates can choose 3 (three) specialties at different higher education institutions of the Republic of Azerbaijan in the appropriate channel; application status and notifications are tracked through the SIACAS personal account
official.application_route: Two-stage official route: home-government nomination first, then registration in the SIACAS admission portal (portal.edu.az) for shortlisted candidates; direct applications to universities are not a route.
official.citizenship_residency: Open only to foreign nationals: citizens of Organization of Islamic Cooperation and Non-Aligned Movement member states, Small Island Developing States, and countries sharing common cultural, ethnic and historical ties with Azerbaijan. Citizens of Azerbaijan and individuals whose Azerbaijani citizenship has been terminated are not eligible.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is exclusively for foreign nationals; citizens of the Republic of Azerbaijan are not eligible.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No field restriction: candidates choose from programmes offered by participating higher education institutions of the Republic of Azerbaijan and may select up to 3 specialties at different institutions in SIACAS.
official.duration: Bachelor's 4-5 years; general medicine 5-6 years; Master's 1.5-2 years; medical residency 2-5 years; doctoral (PhD) 3 years; language preparatory courses 6 months to 1 year, as determined by the higher education institution
official.description: The Heydar Aliyev International Education Grant is a Government of Azerbaijan scholarship programme established by the presidential decree of 8 July 2023 and run by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Science and Education through the Study in Azerbaijan project, honouring the memory of Heydar Aliyev. It awards 100 educational grants annually to foreign students at preparatory, bachelor's, general medicine, master's, medical residency and doctoral levels, with applications accepted over a five-year period beginning with the 2024-2025 academic year.
official.english_requirement: Applicants willing to study in English must have a minimum IELTS 5 (TOEFL 40) for undergraduate programmes and IELTS 5.5 (TOEFL 50) for postgraduate programmes, and the language of study of the previous education must be English; for Russian, Turkish or Azerbaijani instruction, proof of language proficiency or prior study in that language is required. The higher education institution may also examine the candidate's proficiency.

not_confirmed: 2027/2028 cycle application dates and deadlines - the next annual round has not been announced on the official pages as of 10 October 2026

The call's annexes (nomination form, eligible-country list, list of diplomatic missions, participating higher education institutions and programme list) are attachments to the official call document and are not individually enumerated on the web pages
verification.notes: The 800 AZN (470 USD) monthly allowance, 200 AZN (117 USD) yearly medical insurance, tuition and language-course coverage, annual international flights, visa and residence-permit benefits, the two-stage timeline (15 April 2026 nomination deadline; SIACAS registration 1-10 June 2026), age limits, the 70/100 GPA threshold, IELTS 5/5.5 minima and all document rules were read verbatim from the official 2026-2027 'Heydar Aliyev - International Education Grant Program' call document hosted on studyinazerbaijan.edu.az, and cross-checked against the Ministry of Science and Education programme page and the portal's financial-support page.

applicant_utility.summary: This Government of Azerbaijan scholarship funds 100 foreign students a year at bachelor's through doctoral level, covering tuition, language preparation, a monthly allowance, an annual round-trip flight, medical insurance and visa costs. The decisive step is not a direct university application but official nomination by your home government, which must happen by 15 April; only nominated candidates may then register in the SIACAS portal during a tight 1-10 June window and choose up to three specialties. English-taught applicants need IELTS 5/5.5 and prior English-medium study, and every document must be notarized and submitted as PDFs. With the 2026/2027 round closed in September 2026, applicants should monitor the Study in Azerbaijan portal from early 2027 for the next annual call.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Students with strong transcripts (GPA 70/100 or above) from OIC, Non-Aligned Movement, small-island or culturally tied countries who want a fully funded degree in Azerbaijan taught in English, Russian, Turkish or Azerbaijani.
application_readiness_checklist: Approach your country's Ministry of Education or Foreign Affairs, or the Azerbaijani diplomatic mission, months in advance - nomination is stage one and cannot be completed individually
Get diplomas and transcripts notarized in Azerbaijani, Turkish, English or Russian, or with a notarized English translation, and keep clear PDF copies
Schedule HIV/AIDS and Hepatitis B/C testing early so the medical certificate is dated within 3 months of submission
Book IELTS (5 undergraduate / 5.5 postgraduate) for English-taught programmes, or document prior study in Russian, Turkish or Azerbaijani
Draft a motivation letter and CV and gather any local or international award certificates
If shortlisted, register in SIACAS (portal.edu.az) between 1 and 10 June and select up to 3 specialties at different institutions
common_rejection_risks: Applying directly to a university without home-government nomination - only nominated files enter evaluation
Documents in an unlisted language without notarized translation, or uploaded in a non-PDF format
A medical certificate dated more than 3 months before submission
Previous-degree GPA below 70/100 or 7/10, or an equivalent scale that was never documented
Age above the programme limit: 35 for undergraduate/general medicine, 40 for graduate/medical residency, 45 for doctoral (as of 15 September)
Failing to confirm the scholarship offer inside SIACAS within the set deadline - the seat then goes to another applicant
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The call states that any expense not specified in it will not be covered or reimbursed, so applicants fund travel outside the one annual round trip, the unpaid July and August months, internal transport, personal spending and any pre-arrival costs themselves.
document_audit: The medical certificate must come from a clinic in the country of residence and be dated no more than 3 months before submission
All documents must be legible, notarized and uploaded as PDFs in SIACAS before the stage-two deadline (10 June, 6 PM Baku time)
Dual nationals may submit only one application, under one eligible nationality, as nominated by their respective state body
Transcripts must evidence a GPA of at least 70/100 or 7/10 - applicants from other marking systems should prepare a documented conversion
alerts: The 2026/2027 cycle has closed (final arrival date 30 September 2026); the next annual round is expected around early 2027 but is not yet announced - monitor studyinazerbaijan.edu.az
Nomination by your government does not guarantee the award, and the Selection Committee's decisions are final and not subject to appeal
The monthly allowance is paid for only 10 months a year - July and August are unpaid, so budget for those two months
All benefits apply only for the duration of the admitted programme, not beyond it
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Stage one: nomination pack to your home-country authority by 15 April; if shortlisted, stage two: SIACAS (portal.edu.az) registration from 1-10 June under the Heydar Aliyev grant channel with all documents uploaded; the decision arrives through SIACAS and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by 1 August.
